title: 第3章 罡洞第4章 遗物
lines: 苏午很快找到一个答案：灯光与物体垂直照射下不产生影子。
但是苏午很快想到，那个‘影子诡’可以从各种物体产生的影子里钻出来，而自己根本没办法使灯光垂直照射所有物体！
假设在进入模拟游戏以后，自己并不开灯，携带一把手电进去，使手电垂直照射地面，或许可以不产生影子——也只是或许而已，手电的灯光轮廓，算不算影子？
这种方式有很多弊端，再小心谨慎都有翻车的可能。
苏午又想到医院的无影灯。
他了解了一下无影灯的原理，发现无影灯也只是让本影减到最弱而已，做不到完全消除影子。
纵然无影灯奏效，自己可以在房间里装上无影灯，房间外呢？走廊呢？楼道呢？
他没有那个财力。
既然有光照的地方，难免会产生影子，自己能否选择只在黑暗里行走？
苏午脑海里灵光乍现！
他立刻把手机打开，忽略掉工作群里跳动的一条条消息，打开了名为‘钓鱼佬’的小群。
苏午编辑了一条信息：“各位老哥姐姐，有人出红外夜视仪吗？
或者有人卖这东西吗？求一台性能好的红外夜视仪，一手二手无所谓，预算五千以内！”
发出信息不到五秒钟，一个名叫‘户外钓鱼佬装备大全’的群友就加了苏午的好友。
众所周知，钓鱼是一项户外运动。
夜钓更是钓鱼的一大乐趣所在，野外河边钓鱼，难免磕磕碰碰，有人售卖红外夜视仪，帮助他人在夜间看清道路是再正常不过的。
户外很容易发生各种情况，苏午有一个朋友，就曾经在河边与一头野猪四目相对过。
‘户外钓鱼佬装备大全’加了苏午好友以后，就向他甩了几个链接，都是其店内售卖的各种不同品牌、不同类型的红外夜视仪。
苏午一边向其询问各品牌、类型的红外夜视仪具体情况，一边打开了一个买卖二手商品的APP。
这么贵的东西，总要比较比较心里才有谱。
进入APP主界面，屏幕里就出现许多大数据推送的商品。
因为苏午喜欢在这个APP里浏览一些宠物猫犬、文玩之类商品，所以大数据推送到主界面的也多是这些东西。
平常他看到这些都是一眼扫过，这次却被一件商品吸引了。
那是一件雕琢着神秘花纹、类似动物腿骨且一端包裹錾铜纹路的骨笛。
下面有这件商品的粗略介绍：罡洞冈令、牛骨骨笛、破法镇邪、安定情绪……
商品的介绍字眼挑动着苏午的思维。
他点了进去，而后沿着推送一路浏览了数个类似的商品。
影子诡是超出常理的存在，那么能不能用超出常理的方式来杀死它？
比如用这种类似的法器。
反正是在模拟游戏中，不如试一试？
手机嗡嗡地震动着，左上角不断跳出‘户外装备大全’的头像，苏午斟酌一二，觉得可以尝试。
且要做好两手准备。
他在APP里输入红外夜视仪，搜索相关商品，浏览一圈后心里有了谱，继续与户外装备大全聊天谈价，最终以五千八的价格购入一台二手单筒头戴式红外夜视仪。
因为与户外装备大全在同一城市，对方爽快答应安排店员，直接两小时送货上门。
随后，苏午又在APP里一顿操作，以三千的价格买下一根据说是牦牛骨的‘罡洞’。
他再三与卖家确认了这件罡洞是牦牛骨材质的。
content_en:
Su Wu quickly found an answer: no shadow is produced when the light shines perpendicularly to the object.
But Su Wu quickly thought that the 'shadow trick' could get out of the shadows produced by various objects, but there was no way he could make the light illuminate all objects vertically!
Suppose that after entering the simulation game, you do not turn on the light, but bring a flashlight into it, and let the flashlight shine vertically on the ground. Maybe it will not produce a shadow - it is just a possibility. Does the light outline of the flashlight count as a shadow?
This method has many disadvantages, and no matter how careful you are, it may overturn.
Su Wu thought of the shadowless lamp in the hospital again.
He learned about the principle of the shadowless lamp and found that the shadowless lamp only minimized the umbra and could not completely eliminate the shadow.
Even if shadowless lights work, you can install shadowless lights in the room, but what about outside the room? What about the hallway? What about the corridor?
He doesn't have the financial resources.
Since where there is light, there will inevitably be shadows. Can I choose to only walk in the dark?
An idea suddenly appeared in Su Wu's mind!
He immediately turned on his phone, ignored the messages in the work group, and opened a small group called "Fishing Guys".
Su Wu edited a message: "Dear brothers and sisters, does anyone have an infrared night vision device?
Or does anyone sell this? Looking for an infrared night vision device with good performance, it doesn’t matter if it is second-hand or second-hand, the budget is within 5,000! "
Within five seconds of sending the message, a group member named "Outdoor Fishing Guys' Equipment Collection" added Su Wu as a friend.
As we all know, fishing is an outdoor sport.
Night fishing is one of the great pleasures of fishing. Fishing on rivers in the wild is bound to encounter bumps and bumps. It is normal for some people to sell infrared night vision devices to help others see the road clearly at night.
Various situations are prone to occur outdoors. Su Wu has a friend who once made eye contact with a wild boar by the river.
After adding Su Wu as a friend, the 'Outdoor Fishing Guys Equipment Encyclopedia' sent him several links, all of which were various brands and types of infrared night vision devices sold in its store.
While Su Wu asked him about the details of various brands and types of infrared night vision devices, he opened an APP for buying and selling second-hand goods.
For such expensive things, you always have to compare them carefully.
Entering the main interface of the APP, many products pushed by big data will appear on the screen.
Because Su Wu likes to browse pet cats, dogs, toys and other products in this APP, most of the big data pushed to the main interface are these things.
Usually when he saw these, he would glance at them, but this time he was attracted by a product.
It was a bone flute carved with mysterious patterns, resembling an animal leg bone, and one end wrapped with chiseled copper patterns.
Here is a rough introduction to this product: Gangdonggang Order, Ox Bone Flute, Breaking Laws and Suppressing Evil, Stabilizing Emotions...
The product introduction words stirred Su Wu's thinking.
He clicked in and browsed several similar products along the feed.
The shadow is an existence beyond common sense, so can it be killed in a way beyond common sense?
For example, use this similar magic weapon.
It’s a simulation game anyway, why not give it a try?
The phone was buzzing and vibrating, and the "Outdoor Equipment Encyclopedia" picture kept popping up in the upper left corner. Su Wu thought about it and decided that he could try it.
And be prepared.
He entered the infrared night vision device in the APP and searched for related products. After browsing around, he had an idea in his mind. He continued chatting with the outdoor equipment encyclopedia to negotiate the price, and finally purchased a second-hand monocular head-mounted infrared night vision device for 5,800 yuan.
Because they were in the same city as Outdoor Equipment Encyclopedia, the other party readily agreed to arrange for a store clerk to deliver the goods directly to your door within two hours.
Later, Su Wu made another operation on the APP and bought a 'gang hole' that was said to be a yak bone for 3,000 yuan.
He repeatedly confirmed with the seller that the hole was made of yak bone.
